name: sandtable
description: Open-source CLI that rehearses AI agents on a simulated copy of a customer's world: simulated callers, stateful mock tools, business rules checked on every tool call, deterministic grading and pass^k.

banner.content: sandtable is in **early alpha**: the spec and outputs may still change. See the [roadmap](/roadmap).

instructions: sandtable is an early-alpha, open-source CLI (TypeScript, MIT): https://github.com/sandtable-ai/sandtable. If a flag here disagrees with `sandtable <command> --help`, trust the help output.
Grading is deterministic: pass/fail comes from the world's end state, invariants and the tool-call log, never from an LLM judge.

To draft a domain for a user, read /guides/init and /reference/spec, then run `sandtable validate`, `sandtable lint` and `sandtable review` before any model-backed run. Keep all example data fictional.
Every page is available as Markdown by appending .md to its URL; /llms-full.txt contains the whole site.
